Job Location 
ATHENS DC 
 Job Description 
 At P&G, we combine our iconic brands, global scale, and technology expertise to improve everyday life for consumers worldwide. The Warehouse Orchestration Center in 📍 Aspropyrgos, Athens is a key hub within our supply chain network, where digital innovation and AI-driven solutions help optimize warehousing and distribution operations.
  
 This role is part of a growing effort to develop agentic AI solutions that address complex business challenges. Working with modern technologies, the position contributes to the delivery of scalable, innovative systems with tangible business impact.
  
 💰Compensation details:  for this role the  monthly starting salary is 2.860   EUR Gross (yearly starting salary 40.040 EUR).  We consistently benchmark our salaries against top competitors and every P&G employee’s salary is reviewed at least annually so there is ample room for growth.
  
 As a Junior Gen AI Engineer , you will collaborate with Product Owners and warehouse operations stakeholders to understand business needs and develop AI-powered solutions that enhance warehousing, distribution, and logistics processes. From solution design and implementation to deployment and optimization, you will contribute to technologies that support critical supply chain operations and deliver measurable business value.
  
 Key responsibilities include: 
  
 Design, develop, and test Generative AI applications and features using Python and modern AI frameworks.
 Build proof-of-concepts and contribute to the development of scalable AI solutions that address business and warehouse operations needs.
 Develop and maintain AI-powered applications, APIs, and integrations with enterprise systems and data sources.
 Participate in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and continuous improvement activities to enhance solution performance and quality.
 Support solution deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization across the application lifecycle.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior engineers while applying software engineering, security, and responsible AI best practices.
  
 What we offer: 
   
 Business responsibilities from Day 1 – You will start working on key brands from the beginning. Over time, as you expand your impact on the business, your responsibility and ownership of a brand will quickly grow.
 Continuous coaching & mentorship – We are passionate about our work and your growth. We will make sure you receive formal training alongside regular mentorship from your manager and experienced colleagues, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.
 Opportunity to work in a dynamic and respectful work environment – We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily and focus on safety, respect, and inclusivity for all. We value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work-life balance.
 Recognition of Your Contributions – Your hard work and achievements will not go unnoticed. We celebrate success and recognize individual and team contributions to our collective goals.
 Competitive salary and benefits program – Regular salary revisions and possible promotions - all in line with your results, performance and potential.
 
 Job Qualifications 
 Our ideal candidate has: 
   
 General qualifications: 
 Minimum Bachelor’s degree graduates with studies in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field.
 Any previous experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, or a related area is preferred.
 Proficiency in English language (both in writing and speaking).
 Completed/Permanently exempt from Military Service Requirement (if applicable).
 Ability to collaborate effectively within diverse and cross-functional teams in a fast-evolving technical environment.
 
 Generative AI and Data Skills: 
 Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, and AI model evaluation .
 Familiarity with data preparation, processing, and data pipeline concepts used in AI application development.
 Interest in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, agentic AI architectures, and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies.
 
 Software Engineering Skills: 
 Previous experience in Python and a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software development fundamentals.
 Familiarity with API development, databases, systems integration, and software engineering practices, including testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.
 Previous experience with GitHub or other source-control tools, as well as coding standards, code reviews, and Agile development methodologies.
 
 Cloud and DevOps Skills: 
 Basic knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure .
 Familiarity with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI Services, or other cloud-based AI platforms is considered an advantage.
 Foundational understanding of CI/CD and DevOps concepts.
 Basic awareness of application monitoring, logging, and deployment practices.
 
 At P&G #weseeequal 

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. At P&G we strive to build a culture where everyone feels welcome, included, and able to bring their full selves to work.

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process. Please click  here  if you require accommodation during the application process. Please make sure to wait to hear back from us regarding your accommodation before proceeding with the online assessment, we thank you in advance for your patience. 
  
 About us 

 We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene® and more . Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
